{{Quote|You have to understand the Mon Calamari ethos. They were never a warlike species at all until the Empire started enslaving them and ravaging their world. Those wonderful Star Cruisers of theirs were originally passenger liners, you know, that we helped them convert into warships.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
'''Mon Calamari Shipyards''' was a shipwright company that manufactured numerous models of space transports and [[Warship/Legends|warship]]s. The company operated the eponymous, thousand-years old [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards|Mon Calamari Shipyards]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] as well as other smaller [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]. Mon Calamari Shipyards was renowned for its elegant, streamlined ship designs, characterized by bespoke production, unique engineering, and a sculpted, organic hullform. Though originally focused on exploration vessels and luxury liners, Mon Calamari designs emphasized powerful defenses.

When Dac joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Mon Calamari Shipyards became the only shipwright to openly support the Rebellion and became its main source of new warships. The company and its shipyards got known for their advanced and powerful capital warships, in particular their [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]]. Mon Calamari Shipyards became one of the largest starship manufacturer of the galaxy during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. However, the success of the shipwright eventually caused its downfall. The company and its shipyards were seized by the new [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] after the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards were closed by the Empire and its owners were exterminated along with the entire population of Dac.

==Description==
{{Quote|As you may know, each Mon Calamari ship is a unique work of art.|[[Fiz Cor'gril]]|<ref name="FZUS">{{JournalCite|9|Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships (article)}}</ref>}}
Mon Calamari Shipyards was a starship-manufacturing company based on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and present throughout the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]. The company operated the massive [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]] as well as smaller shipyards, such as the [[Krinemonen III]] [[Krinemonen III shipyards|shipyards]]. Among those shipyards, only the Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards were capable to produce the largest models of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]]. Smaller shipyards were usually affected to the construction of smaller starships.<ref name="SoR" />

[[File:Mc80blueprints.jpg|thumb|left|240px|A Mon Calamari with plans for a cruiser]]
Construction of the Mon Calamari Shipyards starships resulted from the collaboration of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] engineers and shipwrights with [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] shipbuilders and [[Mining/Legends|miners]]. The Mon Calamari vessels were widely reputed for their high quality and for their elegance. As the Mon Calamari considered shipbuilding to be an art form, they never construed identical starships, even those from series dedicated to mass-production.<ref name="SoR" />

Mon Calamari Shipyards products encompassed civilian and military vessels. Civilian transports included light [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] (such as the [[Simiyiar-class light freighter|''Simiyiar''-class light freighter]],<ref name="FaDCR" /> the [[MC-18 light freighter]]<ref name="DA" /> or the [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]]<ref name="FZUS" />) and [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liners]] (like the famous [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 luxury spaceliner]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|234|''Kuari Princess''}}</ref>). Mon Calamari military starships ranged from small transports to massive [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]].<ref name="LECG" /> The most iconic Mon Calamari warships were indeed the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] (such as the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 series]] and later the [[MC90 Star Cruiser]]) that could be considered as [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] according to the [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> Smaller military ships included [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] (such as the [[MC-24a light shuttle]] and the [[Crix-class assault shuttle|''Crix''-class assault shuttle]]<ref name="LECG" />), [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] (such as the [[MC30c frigate/Legends|MC30c frigate]],<ref name="SoR" /> the [[ShaShore-class frigate|''ShaShore''-class frigate]] and the [[Tri-Scythe-class frigate|''Tri-Scythe''-class frigate]]<ref name="LECG" />) and standard [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] (such as the [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]]<ref name="SoR" />). Larger warships included [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]] (such as the [[Mediator-class battle cruiser|''Mediator''-class battle cruiser]]<ref name="TEGtW" /> and the [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|MC140 ''Scythe''-class main battle cruiser]]<ref name="LECG" />) and one gigantic model of [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]]: the [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount''-class Star Defender]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==History==
===Early history===
[[File:Mon_Calamari_Shipyards.jpg|thumb|250px|right|[[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards|Shipyards]] above [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].]]
Starship construction in the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]] appeared [[4000 BBY/Legends|over four thousand years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> when the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] people of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] began to dream about what lay beyond their own world. The two sentient species of the oceanic world, the Mon Calamari and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], together constructed several orbital facilities, which in time would because [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]. Thus began the first construction of starliners which explored and colonized the worlds of the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]].<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> These starliners were originally built as exploration vessels for deep voyages into Mon Calamari Space, but carried military-grade [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] wings. Mon Calamari cruisers became the main defense force for a colonial empire spanning several hundred systems in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> Although Dac and its shipyards were discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[4166 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Mon Calamari vessels remained rare outside Calamari Space before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GATORW" />

Near the end of the Galactic Republic, Mon Calamari Shipyards was contracted by [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]]<ref name="SoR" /> to produce [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

===Imperial Era===
{{Quote|Make no mistake, the Mon Calamari saved the galaxy. Their cruisers protected our fleet at the Battle of Endor, allowing the starfighters to penetrate the second Death Star's core. Without Admiral Ackbar and his people, we would all be the Emperor's slaves.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]|<ref name="TNEGtVaV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Kuari_Princess.jpg|thumb|250px|left|The liner [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] served as prototype for [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]-era models of Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]]
After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Dac was [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari|subjugated]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and its population was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]]. The Empire attempted to upgrade the Mon Calamari shipyards for Imperial use but Imperial engineers did not succeed in adapting the Mon Calamari technology to Imperial standards and the project was abandoned.<ref name="GATORW" /> Finally, Mon Calamari Shipyards' starship-building facilities were taken over by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] to produce [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class cruisers]] for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], though Mon Calamari and Quarren sabotage delayed the project for years.<ref name="SoR" /> Nevertheless, since the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] admired the elegant winged hullforms of the Mon Calamari vessels, Mon Calamari Shipyards was allowed to continue to use its shipyards to build luxury starliners for [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]] and [[Kaliida & Rimward]]. The Mon Cal shipwrights later repaid him by developing every component of these new liners as a prototype for future warships. The Mon Cal shipwrights developed every component of these new liners as a prototype for future warships: the sport lasers on the [[Recreation Deck]] of the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] were equipped with pinpoint [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]], while the [[RNS Queen Amidala IV|RNS ''Queen Amidala IV'']] boasted an innovative Class One [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. These were only small parts of a broader, secret plan for re-armament and liberation of Dac.<ref name="TEGtW" />

[[File:Mc09.png|thumb|250px|right|[[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]]]
Once the Mon Calamari and Quarren managed to [[Calamarian Revolt|overthrow]] their Imperial oppressors in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Dac and Mon Calamari Shipyards openly joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SoR" /> The company upgraded its starliners into combat-capable starships and began to produce new warships for the Rebellion.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards were used to build the large [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruisers]] while smaller vessels, such as [[MC30c frigate/Legends|MC30c frigates]] and [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruisers]], were manufactured in smaller yards like the [[Krinemonen III shipyards]].<ref name="SoR" /> By the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Mon Calamari Shipyards had produced eight new heavy cruisers based on the ''Kuari Princess'' design, and nearly 50 escorts.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type]] and [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Liberty'' type]] Star Cruisers,<ref name="SOTGSE">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> as well as the more combat focused [[MC80a Star Cruiser]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> went on to become the mainstays of the Alliance navy, with ships serving with distinction in numerous battles, including the climactic [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="SOTGSE" />

===Mainstay of the New Republic and Galactic Alliance===
As the Rebel Alliance transitioned into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Mon Calamari Shipyards remained a major builder of warships. Thanks to the massive New Republic funding, the Mon Calamari shipyards doubled their production every year, eventually reaching five percent of the entire New Republic budget. In response, the Mon Calamari shipwrights designed increasingly powerful battleships for the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], like the [[MC80B Star Cruiser]] and later the [[MC90 Star Cruiser]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

[[File:MonCalVongWar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser in center of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fleet during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].]]
After the end of the Galactic Civil War, the Mon Calamari continued to produce state of the art capital warships for the New Republic, including the powerful [[Mediator-class battle cruiser|''Mediator''-class battle cruiser]] and [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount''-class Star Defender]] at the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

By the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the Mon Calamari shipyards had produced the new [[Mon Calamari heavy carrier]] for the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. One of this class, the ''[[Blue Diver]]'', was assigned to the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Second Fleet]] during the [[Blockade of Corellia]].<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

In the last years of the Galactic Alliance, the shipyards produced various warship classes for the Alliance military, including the [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|MC140 ''Scythe''-class main battle cruiser]], the [[Tri-Scythe-class frigate|''Tri-Scythe''-class frigate]], the [[ShaShore-class frigate|''ShaShore''-class frigate]] and the [[Crix-class assault shuttle|''Crix''-class assault shuttle]].<ref name="LECG" />

===Second Imperial Civil War and beyond===
{{Quote|Reports estimate that at least ten percent of the Mon Calamari population on Dac has been killed. The rest of the Mon Calamari have been ordered into Imperial work camps. The famed Mon Calamari Shipyards, damaged in the attack, will be closed -- with their owners among those marked for termination.|A news report|<ref name="Legacy 24" />}}
After the fall of the Galactic Alliance during the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the Mon Calamari system and its shipyards were subjugated by [[Darth Krayt]]'s new [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. The Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards were entirely converted to produce Imperial military vessels, becoming one the primary sources of Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. Moreover, Mon Calamari Shipyards engineers were forced to improve Imperial warship designs. One of their largest achievements was the construction of the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']].<ref name="LECG" />

[[File:CoreFleetOpensFire-SWL21.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A Galactic Alliance Remnant fleet of Mon Calamari starships battling Imperial forces near the Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]]
In [[137 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], a [[Core Fleet|fleet]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|attacked]] the Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards and stole the ''Imperious'' while it was nearing completion in dry dock. The shipyards, meanwhile, were devastated during the battle, when [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaius Yorub]] rammed the damaged [[Indomitable (Scythe-class)|''Indomitable'']] into them, destroying a third of the yards and damaging another quarter.<ref name="Legacy 21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref> In retaliation, Darth Krayt later ordered the massacre of the entire population of Dac. Furthermore, the damaged Dac shipyards were closed as Mon Calamari shipwrights were among the victims of the [[Genocide on Dac|genocide]].<ref name="Legacy 24" />
